Approvals.title: Access requests
Approvals.subtitle: Signups that confirmed their email and are waiting for approval.
Approvals.empty: No requests waiting for a decision.
Approvals.loadFailed: We could not load the requests. Tell the technical team: the Firestore index may be missing.
Approvals.conflict: Someone else decided this request before you.
Approvals.accountsSubtitle: Accounts that were granted access, through sign-up or before it existed. Removing access ends open sessions within 5 minutes and can be undone; deleting removes the account and its sign-up record.
Approvals.accountsLoadFailed: Could not load the accounts. Let the technical team know.
